responsibility: Defines the ISO terminal-device channel interface in the gm2 I/O subsystem. It introduces the accepted terminal open flags and procedures to open a ChanId connected to the controlling terminal, test whether an existing channel is terminal-backed, and close it, specifying the text/raw, read/write, and echo/interactive behavior that distinguishes terminal channels from ordinary files or sockets.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for terminal channels: it names the accepted open flags and declares Open, IsTermFile, and Close, whereas the same-stem .mod file contains the terminal device machinery behind those operations.
